verdict.rationale: Jira's own feature page explicitly claims customizable fields and workflows [jira-docs-3, jira-docs-13], with global and project-level configuration [jira-docs-16] and customizable templates [jira-docs-5]. A community user confirms 'a good amount of customization' [jira-comm-1]. Criticism of the limited-transitions model [jira-comm-3] is about workflow design philosophy rather than a failure of customization. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of field and status configuration (beyond marketing one-liners), explicit mention of custom workflow statuses, and hands-on corroboration of a PM configuring them.
